purpose: Define a non-circular relational representation for possible observation orientations and their boundary/domain-indexed admissibility without selecting a unique dominant orientation.

representation_choice.orientation_family: Relational family object with a governed membership relation, not necessarily a bare set or geometric space.
representation_choice.reason: This permits finite, infinite, quotient, representative, or partially specified orientation families without silently assuming cardinality or topology.
representation_choice.delta_alpha: Not used and not defined by this artifact.

type_universe.RelationalDomain: Typed domain governing interaction and orientation admissibility.
type_universe.BoundaryInteraction: Relational interaction condition within a declared domain.
type_universe.ObservationOrientation: A candidate reference-relative orientation evaluated within a declared symmetry scope.
type_universe.OrientationFamily: A typed family equipped with an orientation-membership relation.
type_universe.AdmissibleOrientationFamily: An OrientationFamily restricted by a declared admissibility predicate.
type_universe.AdmissibilityResult: A diagnostic Boolean or classified result returned by the provisional admissibility predicate.

Omega_obs.meaning: Possible observation orientations available for evaluation relative to >S< within D_rel.
guards: not a set of conscious observers

AdmObs_x.meaning: Determines whether an observation orientation remains admissible under B_x and D_rel.
guards: does not select a dominant orientation

Omega_x_adm.membership_rule: MemberOrient(omega, Omega_x_adm, >S<, D_rel) iff MemberOrient(omega, Omega_obs, >S<, D_rel) and AdmObs_x(B_x, omega, D_rel) = ADM_OBS_TRUE
Omega_x_adm.meaning: The family of observation orientations remaining admissible after boundary conditioning.

preconditions: B_x is a valid BoundaryInteraction in D_rel.
admissibility_contract.evaluation: AdmObs_x(B_x, omega, D_rel) evaluates only orientation admissibility relative to the declared interaction and domain.
postconditions_false: the exclusion is local to B_x, omega, and D_rel
admissibility_contract.undefined_behavior: Return a diagnostic undefined result; do not coerce malformed inputs to false and do not repair them.

family_cardinality_guards.empty: Omega_x_adm = empty means no observation orientation is admissible for bounded realization under the declared interaction and domain.
family_cardinality_guards.singleton: A singleton Omega_x_adm permits a candidate reference orientation but does not itself prove selection semantics.
family_cardinality_guards.multiple: A multiple-member Omega_x_adm requires a separate DomOrient_x, quotient, ranking, or equivalence rule.
family_cardinality_guards.infinite_or_unstructured: An unspecified or non-finite family remains admissible as a provisional type if its membership and admissibility relations are defined.
family_cardinality_guards.non_annihilation: None of these cases implies >S< is empty or symmetry is destroyed.

downstream_contract.next_chain: B_x -> Omega_obs -> AdmObs_x -> Omega_x_adm -> DomOrient_x -> o_x -> [Asym]_x -> <S>_x
downstream_contract.Excl_obs_binding: Excl_obs_x(B_x, Omega_obs, D_rel) returns Omega_x_adm when its preconditions and admissibility evaluations are defined.
downstream_contract.selection_separation: DomOrient_x is not defined here and must not be inferred from Omega_x_adm.
downstream_contract.residue: Any excluded-orientation trace remains a future ExclusionResidue definition.

adversarial_tests.name: NO_OBSERVER_REQUIREMENT
adversarial_tests.expected: Omega_obs can be typed without conscious observers or measurement apparatus.

adversarial_tests.name: NO_UNIQUE_SELECTION
adversarial_tests.expected: Multiple admissible orientations remain a family; no unique o_x is emitted.

adversarial_tests.name: EMPTY_FAMILY_NON_ANNIHILATION
adversarial_tests.expected: Empty Omega_x_adm yields bounded-realization failure, not symmetry absence.

adversarial_tests.name: DOMAIN_MISMATCH
adversarial_tests.expected: Incompatible B_x and D_rel return a typed failure, not a repaired family.

adversarial_tests.name: SYMMETRY_NOT_FILTERED
adversarial_tests.expected: The membership rule filters omega only and never filters >S<.

adversarial_tests.name: DELTA_ALPHA_INDEPENDENCE
adversarial_tests.expected: Changing delta_alpha does not change this artifact because it is not an input.

open_questions: Should MemberOrient be primitive, derived, or supplied by D_rel?
Should AdmissibilityResult be Boolean, ordinal, or structured diagnostic?
What conditions make a family quotientable or rankable?
How is DomOrient_x defined without circularity?
How are excluded orientations represented in residue?
How does this family model map, if at all, into existing D-semantics structures?
next_recommended_action: Define DomOrient_x or an explicit orientation-equivalence rule only after human review of this family/admissibility contract.
